name.zh: 爱格兰姆财团王都高级酒店

periods.description: A newly opened luxury hotel in the royal capital operated by the Aingram Group. It hosts Lux and Philphy's engagement party, has private owner rooms and a large bathhouse over hot springs.
periods.significance: Political-commercial party venue and private setting for Philphy and Lux's reconciliation as lovers.
secrets: Philphy uses a fake illness to escape the party with Lux.
